description: February 10 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 3, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 10 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the third decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: February 10 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Ten reduces to 1, so February 10 adds a pioneering push to the Venus decan of Aquarius. The Sun sits around twenty-one degrees into the fixed air sign. This combination tends to be associated with originality that knows how to please: an independent designer, organiser or thinker whose new ideas arrive with surprising grace.

On February 10 the Sun usually sits at about 21° Aquarius, in the third decan, where Venus is the sub-ruler alongside Uranus. Venus, ruler of Libra, softens the closing decan of Aquarius, from about February 9 to February 18. The sign's humanitarian streak picks up warmth, charm and a strong sense of fairness. Mid-February birthdays are often described as friendly idealists who care about justice as much as innovation and enjoy art, design and collaboration. Relationships tend to be valued as partnerships of equals. Venus can make them keen to keep the peace even when a principle is at stake. When this decan pairs its vision with its natural grace, it can make change feel welcoming rather than disruptive.

sections.heading: February 10 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 10th is a compound: 1 + 0 = 1. In Pythagorean numerology this is read as a 1 with a 0 attached, and the 0 is often described as amplifying whatever stands beside it. So the 10th carries the independence and initiative of the 1, with an added sense of potential and of cycles completing and restarting. People born on this day are frequently portrayed as self-reliant and adaptable, able to begin again after setbacks. The day number is secondary to the Life Path, but here it often shows as a quiet, practical resilience.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 10 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 11 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 10: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 10 is the 41st day of the year. By February 19, 9 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Pisces.

For the Chinese zodiac, February 10 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 85 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal. Well-known people born on February 10 include Bertolt Brecht (1898), Boris Pasternak (1890) and Harold Macmillan (1894).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 10?
faq.answer: February 10 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 10?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 10 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 11 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 10th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 10?
faq.answer: February 10 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 85 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 10?
faq.answer: February 10 is also the birthday of Bertolt Brecht (1898), Boris Pasternak (1890) and Harold Macmillan (1894). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
